notes:
Summary: Midbridge EmbedSync is a mid-market SaaS that provides product analytics dashboards augmented with semantic search over customer event logs. They're running a Pinecone-backed vector layer today for embeddings and want to evaluate Redwood as drop-in replacement for both hosted API (quick start) and Dedicated (predictable throughput / lower unit cost).

Key requirements / POV:
- Workloads: nightly batch embedding jobs (~50M vectors/month), real-time semantic search for product UI (target 150-250 qps peak, 50ms retrieval SLA), reranking for top-N results.
- Throughput: need confidence Dedicated can sustain 200 qps 95th percentile for 3k concurrent users. Emphasis on steady-state throughput + predictable token cost.
- Vector DB integration: must validate connector patterns to Pinecone (migration path) and test compatibility with open-source vector stores (Weaviate) for future flexibility.
- Batch jobs: support for large bulk-embed pipelines (Spark/Beam) and resume/retry semantics, plus prefix/KV cache options to reduce costs on repeated queries.
- Security/compliance: SSO (SAML) required, audit logging of inference requests, customer-managed KMS preferred, data residency for EU customers.

Quotes / Call notes:
- "We like the idea of starting hosted to unblock product, but committed costs push us to Dedicated if performance/cost math checks out." — Head of Product (Maya).
- "Need to see a tight plan for the nightly jobs — how do you batch and ensure we don't get throttled or hit token spikes?" — Engineering Lead (Tom).
- "Procurement wants two pricing scenarios for comparison: 12-mo reserved vs hybrid (reserved + burst)." — Finance (Alyssa).

Technical asks outstanding: detailed quantization options for our model family, kernel selection implications for our 4k sequence lengths, end-to-end example of RDW -> Pinecone migration pattern, SLA for Dedicated where fallback to Hosted happens.

Attachments referenced: pricing-deck-v2.xlsx (drive:/deals/embedsync/), sec-faq.pdf (drive:/security/embedsync/).

Next steps (short): finalize Dedicated SOW + pricing by 2026-03-12, schedule POC kickoff (env access), SE to deliver migration playbook and batch job tuning notes.

CRM shorthand: POC = 4w dedicated (50M vectors/day test window), eval metrics = cost per 1M tokens, 95p latency @ 200 qps, successful Pinecone snapshot import.
